<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device" version="24.7.17">
 
 <diagram id="recommendation-flow" name="02 Recommendation flow">
 <mxGraphModel dx="1400" dy="1160" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="1440" pageHeight="1160" background="#FFFFFF" adaptiveColors="auto">
 <root>
 <mxCell id="0"/>
 <mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>
 <mxCell id="number" value="<b>02</b>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#172B4D;strokeColor=#172B4D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#FFFFFF;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=20;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=ellipse;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="34" width="52" height="52"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="title" value="Evidence first. Decisions in Python." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=30;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=1;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="110" y="26" width="1040" height="44"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="subtitle" value="A shared recommendation pipeline · conversation adds interpretation and clarification from PRD 07" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="110" y="75" width="1180" height="28"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="status" value="TARGET MVP · PLANNED" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=right;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;fontStyle=1;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1110" y="28" width="280" height="32"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="collect" value="01 COLLECT & VALIDATE" style="swimlane;startSize=34;horizontal=1;rounded=1;arcSize=8;container=1;collapsible=0;pointerEvents=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#F8FAFD;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D7E0EC;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#52657D;align=left;spacingLeft=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="140" width="1360" height="180"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="context" value="<b>Start request</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Create run ID + shared limits<br>Form / conversation input</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="collect">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="65" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="input" value="<b>Interpret &amp; validate</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Local chat model; typed form input<br>Same UserRequirements schema</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="collect">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="370" y="65" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="valid" value="<b>Valid &amp; complete?</b>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DF;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=rhombus;" vertex="1" parent="collect">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="710" y="55" width="260" height="100"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="clarify" value="<b>Ask for clarification</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Await input; preserve corrections<br>Revalidate before continuing</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DF;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="collect">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1060" y="65" width="270" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="context-input" value="" edge="1" parent="collect" source="context" target="input" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="input-valid" value="" edge="1" parent="collect" source="input" target="valid" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="valid-clarify" value="No" edge="1" parent="collect" source="valid" target="clarify" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="clarify-note" value="User reply resumes input validation" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=12;fontColor=#52657D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1100" y="294" width="280" height="22"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="research" value="02 BUILD CANDIDATE EVIDENCE" style="swimlane;startSize=34;horizontal=1;rounded=1;arcSize=8;container=1;collapsible=0;pointerEvents=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#EAF7F2;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D7E0EC;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#52657D;align=left;spacingLeft=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="370" width="1360" height="180"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="catalog" value="<b>Search &amp; details</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Local catalog + approved refresh<br>Keep source dates and conflicts</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="research">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="65" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="reviews" value="<b>Analyze reviews</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Cache first · deduplicate · batch<br>Validate supporting review IDs</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F2EDFC;strokeColor=#9270BE;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="research">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="370" y="65" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="screen" value="<b>Screen ingredients</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Versioned rules + curated aliases<br>Personal matches stay in session</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="research">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="710" y="65" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="eligible" value="<b>Apply hard filters</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Category · availability · INR budget<br>Exclusions + critical evidence</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="research">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1060" y="65" width="270" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="valid-catalog" value="Yes" edge="1" parent="1" source="valid" target="catalog" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.95;entryY=0;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="catalog-reviews" value="candidates" edge="1" parent="research" source="catalog" target="reviews" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="reviews-screen" value="findings" edge="1" parent="research" source="reviews" target="screen" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="screen-eligible" value="checks" edge="1" parent="research" source="screen" target="eligible" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="decide" value="03 SELECT & EXPLAIN" style="swimlane;startSize=34;horizontal=1;rounded=1;arcSize=8;container=1;collapsible=0;pointerEvents=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#F8FAFD;swimlaneFillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#D7E0EC;strokeWidth=1.5;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=14;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#52657D;align=left;spacingLeft=16;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="600" width="1360" height="310"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="any" value="<b>Eligible set empty?</b>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DF;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=rhombus;" vertex="1" parent="decide">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1060" y="50" width="270" height="100"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="rank" value="<b>Rank eligible products</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">0.35S + 0.30R + 0.20I + 0.15P<br>Decimal scores · stable ID ties</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="decide">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="710" y="60" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="manifest" value="<b>Freeze selected evidence</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">At most 3 IDs · scores · findings<br>Validate the evidence manifest</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="decide">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="370" y="60" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="explain" value="<b>Generate explanation</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Selected evidence only<br>At most 2 calls incl. repair*</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F2EDFC;strokeColor=#9270BE;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="decide">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="60" width="260" height="80"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="empty" value="<b>Show zero-result state</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Explain actual limiting checks<br>Never relax constraints silently</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DF;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="decide">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="1060" y="190" width="270" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="claims" value="<b>Claims supported?</b>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FFF5DF;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=16;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;shape=rhombus;" vertex="1" parent="decide">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="25" y="180" width="260" height="90"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="fallback" value="<b>Factual fallback</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Invalid / unavailable generation<br>Use validated facts</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EDF4FF;strokeColor=#5E83BA;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="decide">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="370" y="190" width="260" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="display" value="<b>Show sourced comparison</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">1–3 products · dates · limitations<br>Immutable rank, price and status</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="decide">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="710" y="190" width="260" height="75"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="eligible-any" value="" edge="1" parent="1" source="eligible" target="any" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="any-rank" value="No" edge="1" parent="decide" source="any" target="rank" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="any-empty" value="Yes" edge="1" parent="decide" source="any" target="empty" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="rank-manifest" value="" edge="1" parent="decide" source="rank" target="manifest" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="manifest-explain" value="" edge="1" parent="decide" source="manifest" target="explain" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="explain-claims" value="" edge="1" parent="decide" source="explain" target="claims" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="claims-fallback" value="No" edge="1" parent="decide" source="claims" target="fallback" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#C89A40;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="fallback-display" value="" edge="1" parent="decide" source="fallback" target="display" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="claims-display" value="Yes" edge="1" parent="decide" source="claims" target="display" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=1;html=1;endArrow=blockThin;endFill=1;strokeColor=#657A95;strokeWidth=1.7;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#52657D;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;defaultLabelBackgroundColor=gap;jettySize=auto;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=1;">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="limits" value="<b>Bounded execution</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Proposed: 30 tool calls · 20 model calls · 5 min<br>At most 5 products freshly review-analyzed*<br>Every retry and repair shares these limits</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#F3F6FA;strokeColor=#A4B3C5;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="930" width="430" height="95"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="recovery" value="<b>Failures &amp; cancellation</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Source/model failure → validated partial or failed<br>Cancel/supersede → stop calls; reject late results<br>Missing review analysis uses its stated score policy</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#FDEFF0;strokeColor=#C66B74;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="505" y="930" width="430" height="95"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="audit" value="<b>Redacted execution report</b><br><font style="font-size:14px;color:#52657D">Capture actual outcomes, coverage and usage<br>Empty valid shortlist = completed<br>No raw prompts or personal exclusion details</font>" style="rounded=1;arcSize=12;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#EAF7F2;strokeColor=#4C967D;strokeWidth=1.5;fontColor=#172B4D;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=17;spacing=12;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="970" y="930" width="430" height="95"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="weights" value="S · supported fit R · review evidence I · ingredient evidence P · affordability | Sponsorship never changes eligibility, score or order." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="1045" width="1360" height="24"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="notes" value="* Proposed limits require target-Mac validation. Screening reports limited rule coverage; it does not establish safety or full compliance." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=13;fontColor=#172B4D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="1075" width="1360" height="24"/>
 </mxCell>
 <mxCell id="source-note" value="TR-05, 09, 12–17, 19, 22–27 / PRDs 03–07, 09 / Arrows show stage order; lower panels apply throughout execution." style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=12;fontColor=#52657D;fontStyle=0;spacing=0;" vertex="1" parent="1">
 <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="40" y="1110" width="1360" height="24"/>
 </mxCell>
 </root>
 </mxGraphModel>
 </diagram>
 
</mxfile>
